nina: Heads-up from NebulaCloud pre-GA smoke: several of their marketplace images fail our runtime on AMD nodes (ROCm path). Can we stand up a quick canary before they go live?
arpit: link to smoke?
nebula-pm: https://nebulacloud.status/runs/44 - errors show rocm_driver_version mismatch and hip runtime aborts on kernel 6.1.11.
yara: looking at the logs - hipRTC complains about missing symbols from hsa kernel module. Likely built against newer headers.
tom: if Nebula's packagers bump kernel packages independently, the kmod ABI can break. We should recommend pinning kernel + driver ABI in the marketplace bundle metadata.
marketplace-team: Nebula asked if we can provide a recommended matrix that covers both Nvidia and AMD.
nina: proposed metadata snippet to include in marketplace manifest: 
```nvidia_driver_range: " >= 520.0, < 540.0 "
rocm_driver_range: " >= 5.2, < 5.5 "
kernel_compat: "linux-headers 5.15.x || 6.1.x (tested with 6.1.9)"
```
arpit: would prefer to call out tested kernel builds explicitly instead of loose ranges. For air-gapped SI installs we should provide vendor-signed kernel modules when possible.
yara: agree. Also suggest a lightweight runtime guard: on startup detect nvml/rocm init failure and log a clear hint with recommended bundle link and fall back to CPU quantized model if thresholds are exceeded. That reduces outage surface for customers.
nebula-pm: Nebula ops is OK with a canary image that pins rocm to 5.3.1 and kernel 6.1.9. They want our validation steps.
nina: validation checklist for canary:
- boot image and verify module load: sudo modinfo amdgpu && /opt/rocm/bin/rocminfo
- run inference smoke: ./redwood-smoke --backend rocm --model embed-128 --tokens 256
- compare p95 latency to baseline (< +15%)
- collect dmesg and /var/log/kern.log if failures

tom: will own the smoke harness and results upload. I can add a quick bash snippet: 
```#!/bin/bash
set -e
modinfo amdgpu || (dmesg | tail -n 50; exit 1)
/opt/rocm/bin/rocminfo || (echo "rocminfo failed"; exit 1)
./redwood-smoke --backend rocm --model embed-128 --concurrency 2 --tokens 256 > smoke.out 2>&1
grep "latency p95" smoke.out || true
```
arpit: I will prepare a signed rocm deb and a sha256 manifest for the Nebula artifact bucket. Tagging @marketplace-team for upload perms.
marketplace-team: granted upload to nebula-partner/bundles/canary/ until 4333000000. Please include a short README with kernel and module build ids.
nebula-pm: we'll run the canary on a subset of hosts (10%) then widen. Hold GA until go/no-go signoff.
yara: add regression plan: if canary fails, escalate to driver vendor with a kernel bisect candidate and add link to our rollback image. Also trigger runtime fallback to hosted model endpoints for affected customers.
nina: timeline: create canary artifact today by 18:00 PT, run canary tomorrow 02:00 PT (their night), results by 06:00 PT. Nebula will withhold GA for 24h after go signal.
om: typo? (small reaction)
arpit: I'll also create a small compatibility test suite for SI installers that checks for kernel-module symbol mismatches using nm on /lib/modules/.../*.ko.
nebula-pm: noted. One ask: can Redwood provide a short comms blurb for their release notes?
nina: draft comms: 'We have validated Redwood inference runtime on NebulaCloud canary images (ROCm 5.3.1, Linux 6.1.9). Customers on Nebula's marketplace should use the certified bundles or follow our compatibility guidance to avoid runtime failures. Contact support for migration assistance.'
marketplace-team: fine to use that. We'll add a link to the bundle manifest.
yara: final ask: add telemetry tag in runtime logs when using vendor-bundled drivers so we can track in case of field regressions. 
arpit: can do - will add 'driver_source=marketplace-nebula' field in telemetry events.
partner-ops-bot: ticket created: NEB-78-driver-canary-validation. Linked artifacts: nebula-partner/bundles/canary/.
nina: action items summary:
- tom: smoke harness + results upload (due 4332109999)
- arpit: build signed ROCm deb + checksums + upload (due 4332109000)
- yara: runtime guard + telemetry tag (due 4332112000)
- marketplace-team: publish manifest and grant upload (done)
- nebula-pm: run canary and hold GA until signoff (due after tests)

marketplace-team: Nebula ops confirmed they will pause GA by default until we clear the canary. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept your action.
arpit: :white_check_mark:
yara: :white_check_mark:
tom: :white_check_mark:
